data.title: Client account hiring funnel
data.content:
# Client account hiring funnel

From client demand and commercial contract to profile submission, client interview, and placement or unannounced closure.
data.summary: From client demand and commercial contract to profile submission, client interview, and placement or unannounced closure.
data.subject: a seat funded by a client contract and the candidate moving towards it

states.title: Client demand & contract scope
states.description: The end client identifies project headcount demand or issues a vendor tender. Budget exists if the contract is signed or is contingent on winning the bid.
states.visible_to_candidate: Nothing. The search is not visible publicly.

states.title: Vendor search opened
states.description: Vendor recruiting opens direct outreach or listings. Whether an executed contract or an unawarded bid sits behind it is not disclosed.
states.visible_to_candidate: Outreach messages or job postings without commercial contract context.

states.title: Vendor recruiter screen
states.description: Introductory conversation assessing experience and target compensation against the vendor target margin.
states.visible_to_candidate: A screening call where the rate band is presented as the vendor internal range.

states.title: Vendor technical evaluation
states.description: Technical interview or test task scored against the vendor assessment of the client technical threshold.
states.visible_to_candidate: A technical evaluation round with vendor engineering staff.

states.title: Submitted to client
states.description: The candidate CV is submitted to the client account team for profile review and interview selection.
states.visible_to_candidate: An extended waiting interval while the client reviews candidate batches.

states.title: Client interview round
states.description: Interview conducted directly by client engineering or project management leadership.
states.visible_to_candidate: An external interview round evaluating project and culture fit.

states.title: Offer formulation
states.description: Compensation package calculated from client billing rate minus required gross margin.
states.visible_to_candidate: An offer package structured around vendor compensation models.

states.title: Pre-placement verification
states.description: Client-mandated background checks, certifications, and compliance paperwork.
states.visible_to_candidate: Document requests and compliance background screening.

states.title: Contract signed & project start
states.description: Contract executed and candidate onboarded onto active client delivery.
states.visible_to_candidate: Confirmed start date and client team onboarding.

states.title: Vendor-level rejection
states.description: The search terminates at vendor screening or technical evaluation before client submission.
states.visible_to_candidate: Standard rejection message from the vendor recruitment team.

states.title: Declined by client
states.description: The client declines the CV submission or rejects the candidate after the client interview.
states.visible_to_candidate: A generic rejection relayed by the vendor without client feedback details.

states.title: Search closed unfunded / tender lost
states.description: The search closes because the client tender was lost, project budget was cancelled, or the commercial contract was paused.
states.visible_to_candidate: Unannounced silence or a notification that project requirements changed.

states.title: Requisition filled from internal bench
states.description: The position is allocated to an existing internal specialist released from another account, closing the external process.
states.visible_to_candidate: A sudden search closure notification after advancing through interview rounds.

transitions.label: Contract signed or tender profiles required
transitions.guard: Commercial contract signed or tender requires candidate CVs

transitions.label: Tender lost or client contract cancelled early
Vendor recruiter screen passed
transitions.guard: Expectations aligned with client billing margin

transitions.label: Screening mismatch or rate misalignment
transitions.guard: Candidate rate exceeds allowable vendor margin or skills misfit

transitions.label: Vendor assessment passed
transitions.guard: Technical bar meets vendor expectation of client threshold

transitions.label: Vendor assessment not met
transitions.guard: Profile does not meet vendor internal quality bar

transitions.label: Client approves CV submission
transitions.guard: Client manager accepts profile and requests interview

transitions.label: Client rejects CV submission
transitions.guard: Client manager rejects profile on CV review

transitions.label: Client cancels requisition or loses project funding
transitions.guard: Client withdraws demand during profile review

transitions.label: Client approves interview
transitions.guard: Client confirms candidate meets project requirements

transitions.label: Client declines after interview
transitions.guard: Client decides against candidate after meeting

transitions.label: Client pulls project before signing
transitions.guard: Client cancels funding after offer extended

transitions.label: Background check passed and start date confirmed
transitions.guard: Verification complete and project onboarding commences
